messages.subject: For David | Mining and Metals Executive | Government, ESG and Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear David,

Your leadership of Korn Ferry's EMEA Minerals, Mining and Metals work makes this a focused introduction. I am pursuing senior international mandates where government relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs and country-facing leadership are central to operating continuity and long-term value.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group in Guyana. Since joining AGM in 2020, I have progressed through successive leadership appointments into my current Director-level mandate. I now lead country-facing coordination across regulators, ministries, communities, corporate functions and operating teams in a large-scale gold-mining environment.

My target universe includes major mining, metals and industrial groups such as ArcelorMittal and comparable multinational platforms, alongside energy-transition and infrastructure businesses. My experience spans permitting and regulatory coordination, stakeholder strategy, responsible mining, social investment, renewable-energy transition, carbon-data governance and executive issue management. I am globally mobile and open to expatriate, residential and rotational assignments.

My executive CV is attached. I would value consideration for searches where operating credibility in a complex resource jurisdiction, institutional judgment and senior stakeholder leadership are central to the mandate.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
https://ragunauthramsaroop.com/
https://www.linkedin.com/in/ragunauth-ramsaroop/

messages.subject: For Andrew | Corporate Affairs, Government Relations and ESG Executive | Global Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Andrew,

Your leadership across Corporate Affairs, Sustainability and Impact in EMEA makes this a focused introduction. I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates spanning corporate and external affairs, government relations, ESG, social performance and strategic stakeholder leadership.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group in Guyana. My current scope integrates government and regulatory relations, ESG, social responsibility, corporate affairs, executive communications, institutional engagement and cross-functional execution in a high-scrutiny industrial environment. I advise senior management on stakeholder risk, regulatory expectations, community priorities and reputation-sensitive matters.

My target universe includes multinational groups such as Siemens, Eaton, AB InBev, HSBC, Roche, Novo Nordisk and ASML, where corporate affairs and responsible-business leadership operate across multiple jurisdictions and stakeholder groups. I also bring direct mining and energy-transition exposure. I am globally mobile and open to relocation, expatriate and rotational assignments.

My executive CV is attached. I would welcome consideration for current or upcoming searches where strong institutional judgment, government interface and accountable ESG execution are required.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.

messages.subject: For Dominik | Industrial, Energy and ESG Executive | European and International Mandates
messages.body:
